identity.description: TranscriptAPI.com: a hosted REST API and MCP server for YouTube data (transcripts, video metadata, search, channels, playlists). Separate from the open-source youtube-transcript-api Python package.
identity.identity_notes: Vendor site and docs describe the product as a hosted REST API and MCP server for YouTube data, matching the transcriptapi.com hint. Company name not stated beyond the TranscriptAPI.com brand. 'YouTube Transcript' is a generic name shared by many unrelated open-source packages and Apify actors, which are not this product.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth is used only for the hosted MCP connection from Claude and ChatGPT (ChatGPT requires a Client ID and Client Secret; Claude can register automatically). REST API uses bearer API keys. OAuth grant type not specified in pages read.
auth.scopes_notes: No scopes described in pages read.

access.production_restrictions: Credit-based usage: 100 free credits to start. Credit exhaustion returns HTTP 402, which can also mean no active paid plan. Higher rate limits and custom plans require contacting the vendor.

read_ops: Channel resolve, info, search, videos, playlists, posts, sections, latest (GET /youtube/channel/*)
api.rate_limits: Starter Monthly: 200 requests per minute; Starter Annual and OpenClaw: 300 requests per minute (more on request). Applies per account, shared by all keys.
api.limitations: All 13 documented REST endpoints are GET (read-only); no write operations listed. Deprecated aliases /youtube/video/info and /api/v1/youtube/transcript exist. Rate limit 200-300 req/min per account. No webhooks documented.
